item.artDescription: This furniture is engraved with a portrayal of a dragon wearing a formal shirt. The work is shaded in hues of gray and orange.

На этом предмете мастер выгравировал, как сельдь, которого окружают террористы, определяет смерть пятиухих свинокарликов. Ягуар появляется в сторонке. Заметно, что каким-то образом изображению удаётся одновременно передать и идею тирании, и идею бога.

This furniture bears a representation of Mariana 'Miana' C da Silva being disabled with cold efficiency. Seven woodpeckers look on. The image contrasts fellowship with cruelty. Strikingly, the whole image is depicted by the careful arrangement of dozens of echidnas. This depiction relates to the incapacitating of Miana by Strong on 12th of Jugust, 5201.
This furniture bears an image of a gunsmith wearing a baseball cap. If you squint your eyes, the rectangular composition of the image reveals the outline of a cherry tree.
This furniture is engraved with a representation of a clam holding a rapier. The work makes the viewer think of depression. The lower part of the image is dominated by a bamboo tree.

li.combatLogText: <color=#D09B61FF>Jaguar</color>, moving a javelins's point dexterously, stabbed <color=#D09B61FF>the agrihand</color> in the thorax.
<color=#D09B61FF>Manatee</color>'s pilum (thrown) perforated <color=#D09B61FF>the lifter</color>'s thorax to pieces.
